latency_machine: Apple Silicon development Mac; exact platform recorded at execution
severe_confusion_definition: True benign/likely_benign predicted likely_pathogenic/pathogenic, or reverse; separate conditional rates for each true side. Uncertain is excluded from those denominators.
rationale: Pre-test project engineering criteria, not validated clinical standards. Macro-F1 floor is below training CV 0.6403; recall floor prevents that average from hiding the known weak Likely pathogenic class. Compare against both baselines. Acceptance uses point estimates with reported bootstrap intervals; no claim of statistical superiority. Fixed calibration/quality rules are selected only on validation rows.
test_reuse_policy: First use consumes both reserved holdouts for this split. No overwrite/retry on a fresh directory to disguise test reuse. Future changes need a new holdout or an explicitly labeled reused-test study. Rendering saved predictions is allowed without rescoring.
